instructions.base: I'd like a spare food-preparation vessel like one of the two I just used. Match its broad handle layout; small auxiliary grips needn't match. Any brand, colour, material or size is fine. Add one vessel, not a set; a lid is fine.

clarification.canonical_answer: The second one I just used, the one I poured into.

composite_events.request: I need one for the second kitchen too. Make that two vessels of the same kind in total.
The cupboard in the second kitchen is small. Make one of the two no more than eight inches in diameter; the other can be any size.
